name: Standardize Converts Datatypes
description: Like issue #639, standardize converts non-string data types to strings.

name: Custom Functions: Positional based not working correctly with kwargs/parameter defaults
description:
Fails as trying to pass too many args.

If z is not passed a value, it appears to be trying to provide a positional arg, but that goes to the first param, x.

name: trim doesn't work on number values
description: Trim needs to convert all inputs to strings so that it runs regardless of the columns data types.

name: matrix write swallows errors
description: If there's an error in a matrix (write), eg a missing column, the error does not surface. Instead, the write just outputs the current dataframe to the existing sheet.

name: sample edge case (minor bug)
description: Tried running sample: 0.5 with batch size of 1. It seems to hang (no error, no results). We should handle this.

name: Running Map with attached Recipe errors when sheet name too long
description: Running a medium sized file in XL with a group_by and list column can return missing data in the middle of the payload. The issue appears related to the size of the data.

name: Input connector not working in Excel
description: Input connector is not working in XL in the read section because the data is not sent to the backend.

name: [REFACTOR] Lookup Actions & [BUG] Request Key Colm
description: When running upsert, unspecified columns are deleted. Train actions should maintain data that was not explicitly requested to change. Key should also be supported as a standalone or additional return value.

name: Tests Creating Large Number of Actual Wrangles
description: Tests appear to be generating a large number of actual wrangles. Wrangles generated by tests should be deleted promptly or mocked.

name: [BUG] extract.ai acts up when columns already exist
description: When an output column of extract.ai already exists, it affects the output of the extract. Existing output values can replace newly extracted values instead of returning the extracted result.

name: mysql in schema twice
description: The MySQL connector appears twice in the schema.
